FN-7HYRV2-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 367
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Phillip Rigsby
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/28/2023
House Bill 367 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of the State Employees'
Health Insurance Plan (SEHIP) and the Public Education Employees' Health Insurance Plan
(PEEHIP) by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of: (1)
alternative medications recommended by a pharmacist, when the acquisition cost for the
pharmacy is greater than the pharmacy benefits manager reimburses; and (2) medications that
otherwise would have been prescribed absent this bill.
